fieldValues.title: Connect your AI
fieldValues.summary: This editor works with the AI you already use: Claude Code, claude.ai or ChatGPT. Open **Agents**, choose **Connect an agent**, then **Pair an agent…** in its ⋯ menu. Give the connector link to your AI as a custom connector, and type the code when it asks. Keep this tab open while your AI works.
fieldValues.explanation:
Make one agent per AI in **Agents** (Connect an agent), then open its ⋯ menu → **Pair an agent…** for a connector link and a pairing code. The code refreshes about every ten minutes; the link holds no secret.

| Your AI | Where the link goes | When it asks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Code | `claude mcp add --transport http <name> <link>`, then `/mcp` and sign in | type the pairing code |
| claude.ai | Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector | type the pairing code |
| ChatGPT | Settings → Connectors (developer mode) → create a connector, authentication OAuth | type the pairing code |

Keep this tab open: your AI works through it, and its changes stay unsaved until you Save.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: Confirm the writer is connected by calling ui_help; if not, walk them through the steps for their client from the table in this feature's explanation, and use ui_highlight on shell.connect-ai to show them the Agents panel.
